projects.name: Skyra Tower
projects.tagline: Studios, 1–2 bed apartments and duplex penthouses with private pools
projects.address: Business District, Bahria Town Phase 8, Rawalpindi

location.note: Placed at the Bahria Town Phase 8 Business District (OpenStreetMap); the website gives the district, not coordinates.

projects.description: A G+9 residential tower in the Business District of Bahria Town Phase 8: a residents' clubhouse (gym, snooker, day care) on the lower ground, 9 double-height showrooms at street level, clinics and offices on the 1st and 2nd floors, 75 apartments (studio, 1 and 2 bed) on the 3rd–7th floors and three 4-bed duplex penthouses with private infinity pools on the 8th–9th.

payment_plan.summary: 30% down · 65% over 36 monthly instalments · 5% on possession

projects.offer: 15% off on full payment (per the website)

projects.description: The final chapter of the Goldcrest Views community at Downtown Giga, DHA Phase II: a curved tower with one face towards the Margalla Hills and the other over G.T. Road, studios to three-bedroom residences (some with a private terrace pool), about 8.5 kanal of amenities on the 26th floor and a rooftop panoramic pool. By Giga Group (Goldcrest Views I & II delivered).
